assertions.description: Working directory is agentic-starter-kits repo root
Agent directory exists under agents/
Agent has main.py (standard agent pattern)
Agent has agent.yaml with name field
Agent has Makefile with deploy targets
Integration tests do not already exist for this agent
Shared integration test infrastructure exists at tests/integration/
Agent path argument provided and non-empty
assertions.pass_if: First word of skill args contains a / separator (e.g. google/adk)

assertions.description: __init__.py exists in tests/integration/
conftest.py exists with shared fixture re-exports
test_deployment.py exists with health check test
conftest.py re-exports shared fixtures via 'from integration.conftest import cluster_auth, repo_root'
test_deployment.py has @pytest.mark.integration marker
test_deployment.py has test_health_endpoint function
test_deployment.py uses deployed_agent fixture
Makefile has test-integration target
test-integration target sets PYTHONPATH to repo root tests/
Unit test target ignores tests/integration/
CI workflow matrix includes the agent path
CI workflow YAML has valid syntax after edit
assertions.pass_if: The agent-deployment-test.yaml file has valid YAML syntax. The matrix entry follows the pattern: { name: <slug>, dir: agents/<path> }

assertions.description: pytest --collect-only passes with no import errors
assertions.pass_if: Running PYTHONPATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/integration/test_deployment.py --collect-only -q from the agent dir shows 1 test collected, no errors

phase-5b-live.description: Phase 5b: Live cluster integration test (if cluster available)

assertions.description: Logged into OpenShift cluster (required for live test)
make test-integration passed against live cluster
assertions.pass_if: make test-integration completed with exit 0, test_health_endpoint PASSED, agent was deployed, health-checked, and torn down successfully. OR: cluster not available, test skipped with reason documented.

waiver.condition: No cluster access available (oc whoami fails or not in ci-testing namespace)
waiver.action: Skip live test, document that it was not run. Test collection (5a) is sufficient for PR.

phase-5c-consistency.description: Phase 5c: Cross-agent consistency check (adapts to discovered capabilities)

assertions.description: conftest.py follows the correct pattern for the agent's discovered capabilities
assertions.pass_if: If agent has no extra env vars: conftest.py is a 2-line re-export using 'from integration.conftest import cluster_auth, repo_root'. If agent has extra env vars: conftest.py is a full file that also uses 'from integration.conftest import cluster_auth, repo_root' and additionally contains INTERNAL_REGISTRY, _REQUIRED_ENV tuple, agent_dir/agent_name fixtures, _write_env_file function, and deployed_agent fixture.

assertions.description: test_deployment.py follows the correct structure for the agent's discovered capabilities
assertions.pass_if: If agent has no extra env vars: test_deployment.py contains INTERNAL_REGISTRY, agent_dir fixture, agent_name fixture, _write_env_file, deployed_agent fixture, and test_health_endpoint. If agent has extra env vars: test_deployment.py is minimal — only imports and @pytest.mark.integration test_health_endpoint function with health_check() call asserting status=='healthy' and agent_initialized is True.

assertions.description: _write_env_file validates the correct required env vars for this agent
assertions.pass_if: The required env vars checked in _write_env_file match what the agent actually needs based on agent.yaml and .env.example. Agents with no extra vars check ('BASE_URL', 'MODEL_ID'). Agents with extra vars define a _REQUIRED_ENV tuple that includes all discovered extra vars.

post.description: All phases complete — integration tests added

assertions.description: All three integration test files exist
Makefile has test-integration target
CI workflow includes the agent
Phase 5a: Test collection passed
assertions.pass_if: pytest --collect-only succeeded with 1 test collected and no errors

assertions.description: Phase 5b: Live test result documented
assertions.pass_if: Live integration test either passed (PASS) or was skipped due to no cluster access (WAIVED with reason)

assertions.description: Phase 5c: Cross-agent consistency verified
assertions.pass_if: New test files follow the correct pattern for the agent's discovered capabilities: no-extra-env-vars agents use 2-line conftest re-export + full test_deployment.py; extra-env-vars agents use full conftest.py with fixtures + minimal test_deployment.py. Env vars in _write_env_file match agent.yaml.
